features.name: AL compiler
features.description: A new compiler for the AL language built using Roslyn architecture concepts and designed as a compiler-as-a-service with language server support.
caveats: Took several years to compile the full base app
Required conversion of internal code before full release

features.name: Partial compilation and recovery
features.description: The AL compiler performs partial compilations with error recovery to enable intellisense and developer experience even when code is incomplete. It reuses compilation results to maintain memory efficiency.
caveats: requires recovery mechanisms for incomplete source
memory efficiency achieved through result reuse
performance sensitive to avoid recompiling unchanged code

features.name: Language Service Protocol support
features.description: Implementation of LSP for communication between the AL language server and editors like Visual Studio Code, allowing intellisense and cross-references.
caveats: requires adherence to LSP standard for language/editor communication

features.name: Symbol reference information wrapping
features.description: A transitional strategy that wrapped the old C-side base app in symbol reference format to allow the new AL compiler to work on top of legacy code without full rewriting.
caveats: Required years to fully compile and convert the base app

features.name: AL transpiler to C#
features.description: The AL compiler transpiles AL code to C# rather than compiling to IL directly. The generated C# is then compiled using the regular C# compiler, with metadata stored in XML and database.
caveats: not producing executable bits directly on operating system

features.name: Text-based source code storage
features.description: Migration from C/SIDE repository-based storage to text-file based artifacts, enabling use of standard source control tools like Git and syntax highlighting in repositories.

features.name: AL Explorer
features.description: A Visual Studio Code web view feature showing application objects with information from running compilation. Allows code navigation and updates in real-time when editing files.

features.name: AL Home
features.description: A news feed feature in Visual Studio Code for Business Central AL developers, providing direct communication channel from Microsoft to developers about updates and announcements.

features.name: Visual Studio Code designers
features.description: Prototype designers for table and page objects in Visual Studio Code, built on the custom designer model which visualizes source code and updates it when changes are made through the designer.

features.name: Compiler API exposure
features.description: Expose the AL compiler as an API for external use. Partners are already using it in an unsupported way. The compiler service was envisioned as a service from the beginning but has not been officially opened or documented for external use.
caveats: used by partners in unsupported ways

features.name: AL extensions in Visual Studio Code marketplace
features.description: AL related extensions available in Visual Studio Code Marketplace, demonstrating partner creativity and ideas in the development area.
